As a Senior ML and AI Technical Solutions Engineer, you play a critical role by helping customers debug and maintain stable GenAI and ML Workloads with AI agent systems using the Databricks Platform. You will develop product expertise end-to-end by advising a broad set of customers and use cases across the space - including products such as Agent Bricks, Vector Search and Model Serving. Reporting to a TSE manager - you will be part of a world class global support engineering organization for Databricks, known for your technical depth and delivering impeccable customer service.
  
  
The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Act as senior technical solution expert for complex issues spanning data pipelines, ML pipelines and/or AI applications, applying deep expertise in distributed systems.
* Analyse and troubleshoot production workloads at the code level, optimise for performance, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Diagnose and support Machine Learning and/or Large Language Model deployments, including real-time and batch inference, autoscaling, monitoring, logging, and alerting. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert guiding customers on experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, evaluation, labelling, tracing, and lifecycle observability.

* Develop expertise in productionizing systems in Databricks and share your knowledge by contributing to wikis and other technical documentation, or by teaching our AI systems new skills, which will be used internally and externally by customers and partners.

8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling Data, Machine Learning, and AI systems on-premises and in the cloud using Python, Scala, and Java in production environments, with expertise in Machine Learning and/or generative AI. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); familiarity with Databricks is a plus. Proficient in data engineering necessary for orchestrating end-to-end machine learning training pipelines, ideally with experience processing large datasets with Apache Spark.
  
  

* SME knowledge in feature engineering, ML frameworks, model training, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies. Proficient in working with algorithms and deep learning, along with NLP techniques.

* Experience developing agent skills, plugins, and debugging with native AI capabilities is a plus.
* Prior support or customer-facing experience is not required for this role, but the ability and desire to develop excellent customer service skills are.
* Prior experience in Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or AI Engineer roles is highly valued.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Professional certifications are good to have.

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. As Data Security Engineering Lead, you will turn approved protection requirements into working sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and classification controls, keep them accurate as the business and its use of AI evolve, and lead the Astellas team that takes over day-to-day operations from our implementation partner.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

* Scope: Microsoft Purview data security capabilities across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Windows endpoints, browsers, and Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools, in a single global Microsoft 365 tenant.

* Data Loss Prevention: Build and tune Purview DLP policies across email, collaboration, endpoint (via Defender for Endpoint) and browser channels, and extend protection to Copilot and AI tools using Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI. Configure policy tips, user notifications and business-justification overrides.
* Classification & Detection: Turn crown-jewel and use-case inputs from the Data Protection Policy & Engagement Lead into accurate detection, using custom sensitive information types, exact data match, document fingerprinting and trainable classifiers. Validate coverage with Content Explorer and Activity Explorer, and reduce false positives using feedback from the business and the Insider Risk team.
* Policy Lifecycle & Operations: Run policy change control from simulation to enforcement and rollback; triage and escalate DLP alerts; configure approved exceptions with expiry dates; and monitor user overrides, reporting patterns back to policy owners.
* Integration & Automation: Send Purview alerts and audit data to Microsoft Sentinel and ServiceNow with the Security Operations and platform teams; automate configuration, reporting and testing with Purview PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; and work with the Insider Risk team to share data loss and insider risk signals, align detections and Adaptive Protection, and use joint findings to tune policies.
* Service Ownership: Own service levels, performance metrics and the operations and engineering runbook; lead knowledge transfer from our implementation partner; and become the Astellas operations owner for the platform by mid-2027.
* Platform Leadership: Own the Microsoft Purview data security platform roadmap and provide input to licensing decisions; oversee our implementation partner's engineering delivery and quality; and lead and mentor the Astellas engineers and analysts who take over day-to-day operations.

  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field.
* 10+ years in security engineering or operations, including 4+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview data security (Information Protection, DLP and data classification) in a production Microsoft 365 environment.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team.
* Experience building custom sensitive information types and tuning DLP policies to reduce false positives at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Endpoint DLP and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* PowerShell scripting, with working knowledge of KQL and Microsoft Graph.

title: AI Operationalization Lead
description:
AI Operationalization Lead

**About Machinify**
-------------------

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how.

**About the Role**
------------------

Machinify is building a dedicated AI Operationalization team, and we're looking for a Lead to run it. Across the company, employees are already using AI tools — Claude, custom Slack bots, one-off scripts and apps — to solve real problems on their own initiative. Some of these "citizen developer" creations are genuinely valuable, but they were built to solve one person's problem quickly, not to run reliably at company scale, under the security, compliance, and support standards Machinify's customers and regulators expect.

The AI Operationalization Lead owns the pipeline that takes those grassroots AI products and turns them into tools the company can actually depend on — hardened, monitored, documented, and owned. Just as important, this role builds the platform, tooling, and repeatable process that make that operationalization faster and cheaper every time, so promoting a citizen-built prototype to a supported internal product stops being a bespoke project and becomes a well-worn path.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

* Build and lead the AI Operationalization team, setting its charter, intake process, and prioritization model for evaluating citizen-developer AI tools.
* Define and run a maturity/promotion pipeline that takes a tool from prototype to production: security review, code and architecture review, testing, documentation, and ownership handoff — with a PHI screen early in the pipeline to flag anything that needs to be handed to the US-based compliance team instead of proceeding locally.
* Design and build the shared platform, templates, and "golden paths" (CI/CD, deployment patterns, reusable components, logging/monitoring hooks) that make it faster to operationalize the next tool than the last one.
* Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal on internal AI governance standards before a tool reaches production. This team does not own HIPAA/HITRUST compliance work: part of the role is recognizing when a citizen-developer tool touches protected health information and routing or escalating that work to Machinify's US-based Security and Compliance teams rather than operationalizing it locally.
* Work directly with citizen developers across the business to understand what they built and why, translate tribal knowledge into supportable systems, and mentor them in engineering practices that make their next build easier to operationalize.
* Establish ongoing ownership: monitoring, incident response, versioning, and a clear support model for each promoted tool, so operationalized tools don't silently degrade or become orphaned.
* Track and report on the health of the citizen-developer-to-production pipeline — what's in the queue, what's been promoted, what's been retired — to IT and business leadership.
* Evaluate and recommend platform, tooling, and vendor choices (internal developer platforms, model routing/gateways, deployment infrastructure) that support the team's mission.
* Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and bring in newer approaches where they meaningfully improve speed, reliability, or governance — with tradeoffs clearly stated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, including production ownership of systems built by others (rewrites, hardening, or platformization of existing prototypes).
* Direct experience working with LLM-based tools and frameworks (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, LangChain-style orchestration, MCP-based integrations) at a practical, hands-on level.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, or self-service tooling that other engineers or non-engineers use to ship work.
* Enough working familiarity with HIPAA/HITRUST-style data regulations to recognize when a piece of work touches protected health information and needs to be flagged or escalated — this role is not expected to own that compliance work directly.
* Experience with generalized process automation beyond LLM tooling — RPA, workflow orchestration, scripting-based automation — since much of what gets operationalized will look more like "automate this repetitive process reliably" than "integrate a language model."
* Track record of leading a small team or function, including setting process, prioritizing intake, and reporting to leadership.
* Strong communication skills — able to work with both non-technical "citizen developer" creators and engineering/security stakeholders, and to explain tradeoffs plainly.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity: this is a new function, and part of the role is defining what "done" looks like.
